title: pilocarpus pennatifolius var. selloanus

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. Further research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of Sello's Pilocarpus, but it is traditionally used as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent.
